mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 2.0%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 30% of cases (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), the economy is in an expansion phase, which typically supports strong corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals robust consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: RSAFS above 12-month MA fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,200,000 units signals a cooling housing market, which typically precedes a slowdown in consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1200 fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 30% of cases (Rank IC < 0.04).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising UNRATE and declining PAYEMS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 35% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy stance typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0.
